reuse.implementation: Existing Frameweave Native dense LK, forward/backward consistency, IRLS model fits, compensated arithmetic, image sampler, resource lifecycle and rational time. Original upstream stabilization source is retained for provenance/design comparison; new banded temporal least squares and local-grid solver are not claimed verbatim Rust ports.
reuse.cost: Upstream CPU Analyzer/plan ties sparse features, camtrack/subspace and Rust serialization together. Reusing current GPU fields and small Compute kernels avoids a second host and pixel/model round trips. No external rendering framework or new GPU owner is added.
reuse.allocationChange: Existing own image-estimation opticalFlow now ping-pongs two fields per pyramid level; same kernels/order/F32 publications; affected legacy GPU/F64 regression included.
reuse.catalog: Read-only effects search stabilization --mode keyword in own FRAMEWEAVE_HOME returned [] before qualification; no external package installed.
